degree.text: Degree Awarded Bachelor Degree of Engineering.

description.text: Teaching Objectives After the course you will be equipped the knowledge of Civil engineering discipline and professional training experience for engineers; Qualified ability for the work of planning, design, construction, management and research in civil engineering projects. Graduates will be able to find great jobs in the field of housing construction, tunnel and underground construction, bridge construction and mine companies. Main Courses Advanced Math, Physics, Theoretical Mechanics, Building materials, Material Mechanics, Structural Mechanics, Soil Mechanics & Foundation Engineering, Concrete Structure, Steel Structure, and Architecture Construction, Elementary Chinese, Survey of China, Intermediate Chinese Please click here to download the timetable of subjects Professional Emphases Jiangsu University offers two majors within the CEPM program. -Civil Engineering, involving the design and construction of buildings and bridges. -Project Management, involving the control and planning of construction projects. Main Courses for Civil Engineering The following key courses are offered during the first period of 3 years Engineering Mechanics Internship Practice, course design, surveying and mapping practice, graduation practice, graduation design. Degree Awarded Bachelor Degree of Engineering.

duration.text: The Civil Engineering at Jiangsu University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Health certificate Not needed during application. But may required when applying for visa. 2.High school academic transcript Transcript in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 3. High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 4. Family Finance Support Photocopy of the financial support statement with signature 5. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 6. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 7. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English.

requirements.text: 1. Be in good health condition, which accords with the Health Standard for International Students stipulated by the China Education Department; 2. Have senior high school diploma and good academic record; 3. Have basic English language ability; 4. Have good moral character and obey the laws and regulations of the Chinese government and regulations of the university. Respect Chinese social customs and habits
